user.title: Connect to Jarvis
user.description: Jarvis watches the house and decides what to do; this sends it what changes, as it happens. Make a device token in Jarvis (Devices) with the scope “the house and cameras”, signed in as the first person (the one who set Jarvis up).

data_description.token: Starts jdv1_. Jarvis shows it once, when it is made.

error.invalid_auth: Jarvis refused the token: check it, and that it has the scope “the house and cameras” and is a device of the first person's.
error.no_house: Jarvis has no Home Assistant set up to watch: add its address and token in Jarvis's Settings first.
error.cannot_connect: Jarvis could not be reached at that address.
